review_status: Evidence reviewed 2026-11-17. WDFW/ODFW species accounts support rocky-bottom depth and habitat; no numeric preferred SST evidence found, and curvature is only qualitatively supported.

profile.size: Min limit 22 inches TL / Bag limit 1-2 per harvester / day
profile.diet: Small fish, crustaceans, squids, and pelagic prey
profile.behavior: Navigates West Coast kelp forests, rocky reefs, and coastal upwelling zones.

factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for lingcod.
factors.value_notes: WDFW and ODFW species accounts describe range and rocky-bottom habitat but do not establish a numeric preferred surface-temperature interval for lingcod. The broad statement that lingcod tolerate varied water temperatures does not validate the configured 7-15 °C range or 9-13 °C ideal. Keep values unchanged and mark needs_source.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for lingcod.
factors.value_notes: WDFW reports most lingcod on rocky bottom at 10-100 m, with records to 427 m; ODFW reports adults near rocks from inshore to 230 fathoms and young fish on sand/mud in bays. This supports depth and habitat relevance but not one 10-150 m / 12-145 m preference across adults and juveniles.

factors.reason_template: Seafloor curvature identifies rocky pinnacles, ledges, and break lines where lingcod ambush prey.
factors.value_notes: WDFW and ODFW document adult lingcod association with rocky bottom, reefs and complex hard structure, while juveniles use sand/mud in bays. This supports structure/relief context but does not directly validate the runtime bottom_curvature metric or its numeric response.
